trigger: post-merge on main or explicit workflow_dispatch only
source_rule: Acquire exact published SD01/SD02/SD03 XLSX artifacts only from the frozen publisher/NCBI allowlist. Never substitute a processed mirror after acquisition failure.
label_firewall: SD01 worksheet cells may not be opened until the persisted assay-preflight receipt is reloaded and its assay_only_sha256 is verified against the persisted assay-only artifact.
raw_xlsx_commit_policy: never commit raw publisher XLSX files
result_mutation_policy: A completed result is immutable evidence for this run. Any code, source, threshold, or policy change requires a new prospective run identifier; never rewrite the prior verdict.
